subject: 🎥 Virtual Session — $session_title on $session_date
body:
Dear $participant_name,

You are invited to a virtual session. The details are below — please add it to your calendar.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SESSION DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Session ID:       $session_id
Classroom:        $classroom_name
Type:             $session_type
Date:             $session_date
Start Time:       $start_time
End Time:         $end_time
Duration:         $duration_minutes minutes
Host:             $host_name
Join Link:        $join_url
Meeting ID:       $meeting_id
Dial-in (audio):  $dial_in

Notes from your host:
$session_notes

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

BEFORE YOU JOIN

  • Test your camera, microphone, and internet connection in advance.
  • Use a wired connection if possible, or sit close to your router.
  • Mute your mic on join; unmute to speak.
  • Have any pre-reading or homework to hand.
  • Aim to join 2–3 minutes early.

Can't make it? Sessions are recorded by default — a recording link will be sent once it is processed.

Kind regards,
Virtual Classroom Team
